**BLUETTI Elite 200 V2** is a solid choice for either appliance. Its **2,600 W AC output** is enough for a typical single-burner induction cooktop rated up to 1,800 W, with some headroom; it has a **2,073.6 Wh battery**. [Specs and purchase link](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2)

Before buying, check the wattage printed on your cooktop or kettle: it must be **2,600 W or less**, and avoid running other high-wattage appliances at the same time. A cooktop running continuously at full power will drain the battery much faster than occasional kettle boils. ([Cooktop power guidance](https://homepowerfacts.com/can-it-run/induction-cooktop/))
